Goes to red alert: a pulsing red frame over the home screen in every interface and the RED ALERT sound looping, with MUTE and STAND DOWN on screen. It never blocks the phone (touches pass through the frame), stays silent in Silent/Vibrate, during calls and with Do Not Disturb on, and stands down by itself after the time below. Assign it to a tile or dock icon: long-press › ASSIGN TREKUI FUNCTION › RED ALERT, or use the Quick Settings tile.
Loop the RED ALERT event sound (SOUNDS section) while on alert
CLOAK and RED ALERT are also tiles for the Quick Settings panel, so they work from anywhere.
Pull down Quick Settings, tap the edit (pencil) button and drag the TREKUI CLOAK and RED ALERT tiles into the panel.
TILE IS ALREADY IN QUICK SETTINGS
You are on %3$s, one of nine interfaces. Seven short stops show you how to make it yours.\n\nSkip whenever you like. The tour is in %2$s › DEFAULT HOME › REPLAY TOUR.
Long-press any tile, dock slot, block, elbow or title (plates and studs on the pipe interfaces) to ASSIGN an app or a launcher function to it, rename it, recolor it or give it its own sound.
Swipe up, or tap %1$s, to see every app. Long-press an app in the drawer for more options, such as hiding it or adding it to the home screen.
Swipe down from the top of home for the shade: notifications, quick toggles and media. If you prefer Android\'s own shade, turn this off in %2$s › SHADE.
Tap %2$s to change everything else: tiles and dock, panels, the clock, the drawer, sounds, weather and smart devices.
%2$s › INTERFACE switches between the Command, Imperial and Collective consoles and the pipe lounges. Each one keeps its own layout, and a snapshot is saved before every switch.
%2$s › BACKUP exports your layout to a file for a new phone. Snapshots are saved automatically before updates, imports, resets and interface switches. UNDO LAST CHANGE puts the previous layout back.
Make this launcher your default Home app so the Home button and gestures bring you here.\n\nYou can switch back any time in Android Settings › Apps › Choose default apps › Home app.
This launcher is already your default Home app. That completes the tour.

Export saves your tiles, dock, panels, element assignments, interface, colors and other appearance settings to a JSON file. Smart-device keys and tokens, and your weather location, are never included. Import shows a preview before it changes anything.
Saved automatically before an app update, an import, a reset, a restore or an interface switch. The newest %1$d are kept.

Icons from the pack replace app icons in the FRAMED and NATIVE styles, on the dock, tiles and every interface; apps the pack doesn\'t cover get its backplate when it has one. Long-press any app in the drawer › CHANGE ICON to pick a single icon.
No icon packs found. Any ADW / Nova-compatible icon pack from the Play Store appears here once installed.
